title: SEC1: owner Message/set attachment inserts not transactional
description: In kith-chat/message.rs process_create, messages().insert() and the subsequent loop of attachments().insert() are separate SQLite statements with no wrapping transaction. If the message insert succeeds but a later attachment insert fails (e.g. duplicate blob_id, disk-full mid-loop), the message row persists with missing attachment metadata — an inconsistent database state with no recovery path. kith-store already has insert_message_with_attachments() that wraps both in a single transaction and is used by the Peer/deliver path. The owner Message/set create path should use the same transactional method. Risk: silent partial write; attachment metadata can be lost without the caller knowing the message was created.
